verdict.rationale: Xero documents connecting bank accounts so that JAX categorizes and matches transactions, with a Mercury bank connection listed. It also documents a Stripe integration for accepting card and ACH payments on invoices, and Gusto appears in the app directory as a payroll platform. However, the Gusto listing only describes Gusto itself and never says payroll activity posts to the Xero ledger, and the Stripe evidence does not show payment activity reconciling automatically. Missing for 10: documented payroll-to-ledger journal sync, explicit evidence that payment-processor activity flows into the ledger automatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts to Xero. Let JAX categorize and match transactions while you're busy with your real work.
Use Stripe to accept online payments by credit and debit cards, digital wallets, Klarna, ACH Debit, and more
